answer: An AI-agent economy can curb Sybil attacks by requiring dynamic Proof-of-Burn deposits. Each agent must verifiably destroy base tokens, submitting burn proofs whose balance delta scales with network traffic. An attacker incurs an unrecoverable capital cost per identity, facing an expenditure zenith during mass registration attempts. However, continuous token destruction risks draining liquidity from the economic ocean, which systematically prices out lower-margin autonomous agents.
